title: post-demo-handover-1on1-vivian-scratchpad
content:
Context and meeting goal:
- Quick 20m sync after Wed demo with Acme Retail (POC trial kickoff). Objective: align on immediate handoff tasks so AE + CS + SE start trial week without friction. Leave the meeting with assigned owners and timelines.

Demo highlights (notes from recording):
- Customer excited about latency improvements and cost projections; CTO asked about private deployment timeline and data residency requirements.
- Main technical ask: SSO + SCIM for pilot users, and a small dataset upload flow for testing embeddings on first 100k rows.
- Risk flag: procurement raised contract amendments around data processing (needs legal review).

Key stakeholders to mention in the 1:1:
- AE: Ethan (owns commercial cadence)
- SE: Noah (technical lead for onboarding)
- Buyer/Champion at Acme: Priya Shah (Head of ML), with CTO Sanjay Rao as escalation contact
- Legal/Procurement: Claire (Acme) - expects standard DPAs but flagged encryption at rest clause

Top agenda items for 1:1 with Ethan (10–15m):
- Confirm AE next steps: pricing range for 3-month pilot, payment terms, and whether we surface Dedicated vs Hosted recommendation for trial.
- Ask Ethan for timeline on procurement touchpoints and intros to Claire.
- Decide on success metrics for pilot (conversion target: 30% of pilot models into production, latency under 200ms median for 2k tokens).

Top agenda items for 1:1 with Noah (10–15m):
- Confirm SE onboarding plan: SSO/SCIM setup window, dataset ingestion checklist, and access to a staging cluster.
- Technical constraints: whether Acme's dataset needs custom tokenization (if so, scope + effort estimate).
- KV cache advice: propose enabling prefix caching for their 1:1 chat use case to reduce token cost during pilot.

Immediate action items (assignments and rough due dates):
- Ethan: send intro email to Claire and Priya with DPA summary + ask for procurement timeline (due: 2026-03-15).
- Noah: prepare staging access doc and simple ingestion script (Python) for first 100k rows; include sample prompt templates (due: 2026-03-13).
- Vivian (me): draft pilot success metrics doc and shared checklist for AE/SE to iterate (first draft due: 2026-03-12).
- Legal (internal): get pre-review of standard DPA + encryption clause (Vivian to ping Legal with summary and Acme redlines) (request sent: 2026-03-09; expected response: 2026-03-16).

Risks and mitigation proposals:
- Risk: Procurement stalls pilot start. Mitigation: propose a time-boxed technical PoC (2 weeks) that can start without full contract signed; require a signed NDA only. Ask Ethan if that's acceptable.
- Risk: Data residency requirement pushes to Private deployment, which adds timeline. Mitigation: propose initial staged evaluation on Hosted with a written data handling plan and then parallel Private onboarding conversation if they proceed.

Notes to bring to live 1:1 (talking points and one-liners):
- "Two pragmatic options: quick technical PoC to prove lift, or formal pilot tied to procurement. Which feels most realistic on their side?"
- "If legal needs extra time, can we push a reduced-scope trial to unblock SE work and surface success metrics?"
- "We should agree on an internal single-threaded owner for onboarding — AE owns procurement, SE owns technical onboarding, CS (me) owns success metrics and adoption tracking."

Follow-ups and templates to attach after 1:1:
- Pilot checklist (to be attached): staging access, SCIM/SSO steps, dataset ingestion checklist, sample prompts, monitoring dashboard metrics.
- Email template: intro to procurement + DPA summary (Vivian to draft post-1:1).

Open questions to resolve in meeting or offline:
- Does Acme require HSM-backed KMS? If yes, that may push to Private or Dedicated.
- Are they comfortable with a Hosted staging cluster for initial tests?
- Who at Acme will approve API keys and access? (need name + email)

Misc notes / scratch thoughts:
- Consider proposing a 4-week pilot priced as a fixed PROOF license to simplify procurement (flat fee + usage cap).
- If they care about quantization options for cost, table the idea for week 2 after data ingestion and initial latency tests.

Post-1:1 deliverables (my checklist):
- Send the pilot success metrics doc to Ethan + Noah (timestamp and link).
- Create the staging access folder in Drive and drop Noah's ingestion script.
- Draft procurement intro email and attach DPA summary for Ethan to forward.

Quick timeline:
- 2026-03-12: internal AE/SE/CS alignment meeting (this).
- 2026-03-13: Noah prepares ingestion script and staging doc.
- 2026-03-15: Ethan intro to procurement + request for timeline.
- 2026-03-16: expect Legal pre-review back.
- 2026-03-18: aim to start technical PoC if onboarding not blocked.

___
Version notes: rough scratchpad — will tidy after 1:1. Intend to convert to a shareable pilot checklist and attach to customer folder once owners sign off.
